detector: Run as a detector under Maat's ruling of 12 Oct 2026: exam bar not met (keep-vs-not 61% isiXhosa / 47% isiZulu); used because false keeps were 0 of 19 and 0 of 1, false cuts 4% and 3%. Flags are leads for Maat, not verdicts.

rows.en: The hill is moving in waves. The cattle have decided not to notice.
rows.draft: Igquma linyakaza ngamagagasi. Izinkomo zinqume ukungaboni lutho.
rows.reason: 'ngamagagasi' (by means of waves) is stiff, a speaker says 'okwamagagasi' (like waves); 'ukungaboni lutho' is 'to see nothing', 'not to notice' is 'ukunganaki'.
rows.rewrite: Igquma linyakaza okwamagagasi. Izinkomo zinqume ukunganaki.

rows.en: The moon keeps popping out to check on the forecourt. Still nothing happening.
rows.draft: Inyanga ihlala iphuma izobheka igaraji likaphethiloli. Akukho okwenzekayo.
rows.reason: 'igaraji likaphethiloli' is redundant, people just say 'egaraji'; the turn needs 'still' ('Namanje') or the second beat goes flat.
rows.rewrite: Inyanga ihlala iphuma izobheka egaraji. Namanje akukho okwenzekayo.

rows.en: Sun's in, sun's out. Monday's doing a soft launch.
rows.draft: Ilanga liyangena, liyaphuma. UMsombuluko uqala kancane.
rows.reason: Plain, natural two beats; 'uqala kancane' carries the soft launch warmly.

rows.en: Gqeberha doesn't sleep, it just holds on.
rows.draft: IGqeberha ayilali, ibambelela nje.
rows.reason: Short and natural; 'ibambelela nje' is how a speaker would put it.

rows.en: The breeze is moving the jacaranda one street over, petal by petal. The stoep approves.
rows.draft: Umoya omncane uthutha i-jacaranda iye komunye umgwaqo, imbali ngembali. I-stoep iyavuma.
rows.reason: Natural; 'imbali ngembali' and 'I-stoep iyavuma' read the way the confirmed lines code-switch.

rows.en: It's 6am and the fridge is already the most popular room in the house.
rows.draft: Ngu-6 ekuseni kanti ifriji isivele iyindawo ethandwa kakhulu endlini.
rows.reason: Natural spoken time phrasing; 'indawo ethandwa kakhulu endlini' lands the fridge joke.

rows.en: The sky's putting on a show. The fish, as usual, are not.
rows.draft: Isibhakabhaka senza umbukiso. Izinhlanzi, njengenjwayelo, azenzi.
rows.reason: 'azenzi' with no object reads as 'they don't do' and loses the show; needs the object concord 'aziwenzi' (they don't put it on) and contrastive 'zona'.
rows.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka senza umbukiso. Izinhlanzi zona, njengenjwayelo, aziwenzi.

rows.en: The moon switched the mountains on. The heat, however, stays off.
rows.draft: Inyanga ikhanyise izintaba. Kodwa ukushisa akuvulwanga.
rows.reason: 'ukushisa akuvulwanga' (the heat was not opened) is odd, heat is not switched on; keep the switch image with warmth that is still switched off ('kusacishiwe').
rows.rewrite: Inyanga ikhanyise izintaba. Kodwa ukufudumala kona kusacishiwe.

rows.en: The washing should have come in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.
rows.draft: Izingubo bezifanele zingene emahoreni adlule. Umoya omncane uvote ukuthi zisale.
rows.reason: 'bezifanele zingene emahoreni adlule' is stiff; a speaker says 'bekufanele zingeniswe' and 'uvotele ukuthi zihlale ngaphandle'.
rows.rewrite: Izingubo bekufanele zingeniswe emahoreni edlule. Umoya omncane uvotele ukuthi zihlale ngaphandle.

rows.en: The washing will be dry before first break. The breeze took the early shift.
rows.draft: Izingubo zizobe zomile ngaphambi kwekhefu lokuqala. Umoya omncane uqale umsebenzi kusenesikhathi.
rows.reason: Natural throughout; the breeze starting work early keeps the weather as a worker.

rows.en: Hand on the cap, one stride at a time. The breeze is pacing her.
rows.draft: Isandla ekepisini, isinyathelo ngesinyathelo. Umoya omncane uhamba naye.
rows.reason: Natural; 'uhamba naye' is softer than 'pacing' but reads warm and right.

rows.en: Perfect weather to bump into someone you've 'been meaning to call'.
rows.draft: Isimo sezulu esihle sokuhlangana nomuntu 'obekumele umshayele ucingo'.
rows.reason: Same shape as the confirmed 'Isimo sezulu esihle se...'; the quoted excuse lands.

rows.en: The moon drops in between clouds. It can smell the meat from up there.
rows.draft: Inyanga ivakashela phakathi kwamafu. Iyalizwa iphunga lenyama isezulwini.
rows.reason: 'ivakashela phakathi kwamafu' uses the applied verb with no one being visited; a speaker says the moon 'iqhamuka' (pops out) between clouds.
rows.rewrite: Inyanga iqhamuka phakathi kwamafu. Iyalizwa iphunga lenyama ikude phezulu.

rows.en: The clouds gave the sun Tuesday off. Nobody told the humidity.
rows.draft: Amafu anike ilanga ikhefu ngoLwesibili. Akekho otshele umswakama.
rows.reason: Natural; 'Akekho otshele umswakama' keeps the dry turn intact.

rows.en: The breeze is still warm at this hour. The sea leaves the heating on all night.
rows.draft: Umoya omncane usafudumele ngalesi sikhathi. Ulwandle lushiya isifudumezi sivuliwe ubusuku bonke.
rows.reason: Natural; the sea leaving the heater on all night carries the image.

rows.en: Cloud over the mountain, potjie under the lapa. Both need another hour.
rows.draft: Ifu phezu kwentaba, i-potjie ngaphansi kwe-lapa. Kokubili kusadinga elinye ihora.
rows.reason: Clean parallel, potjie and lapa kept as people say them; 'Kokubili kusadinga elinye ihora' is natural.

rows.en: The bushveld is on silent mode today. Everyone. Everything.
rows.draft: I-bushveld ise-silent mode namuhla. Wonke umuntu. Yonke into.
rows.reason: Code-switch matches the confirmed 'liku-airplane mode' pattern; short beats work.

rows.en: The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, and yet.
rows.draft: Idolobha Elinobungane alikaze licele ukuba yiDolobha Elinomoya, kodwa noma kunjalo.
rows.reason: City nicknames translated literally are not what people call it, and the trailing 'kodwa noma kunjalo' dangles unfinished in isiZulu; keep the names and close the turn.
rows.rewrite: I-Friendly City ayikaze icele ukuba yi-Windy City, kodwa manje isiyiyo.

rows.en: Clouds all afternoon, not a drop. The hose is back on duty.
rows.draft: Amafu ntambama yonke, akukho ngisho nethonsi. Ipayipi lamanzi libuyele emsebenzini.
rows.reason: Natural; 'akukho ngisho nethonsi' and the hose back at work read right.

rows.en: Tomorrow is a fresh negotiation with the weather. Tonight we rest.
rows.draft: Kusasa yingxoxo entsha nesimo sezulu. Kulobu busuku siyaphumula.
rows.reason: Natural and warm; 'yingxoxo entsha nesimo sezulu' carries the negotiation.

rows.en: No shadows, no glare, no excuses. Monday under a Tupperware lid.
rows.draft: Azikho izithunzi, akukho ukukhazimula, azikho izaba. UMsombuluko ungaphansi kwesivalo se-Tupperware.
rows.reason: Natural three-part list; the Tupperware lid echoes the confirmed line.

rows.en: The clouds are drifting through slowly. It's Sunday; they're allowed.
rows.draft: Amafu adlula kancane. YiSonto; avunyelwe.
rows.reason: Short, natural, 'YiSonto; avunyelwe' lands the Sunday turn.

rows.en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.
rows.draft: Asikho nesisodwa isithunzi enkundleni usuku lonke. Unompempe akazange afinyeze amehlo.
rows.reason: 'afinyeze amehlo' (shorten the eyes) is not a sure way to say squint; say plainly the sun never bothered his eyes.
rows.rewrite: Asikho nesisodwa isithunzi enkundleni usuku lonke. Unompempe akazange ahlushwe yilanga emehlweni.

rows.en: Shoes on the blanket corners. The breeze is welcome, the sand isn't.
rows.draft: Izicathulo emakhoneni engubo. Umoya omncane uyamukeleka, isihlabathi asamukeleki.
rows.reason: First beat has no verb, so it reads like a caption; a speaker would say 'Izicathulo zisemakhoneni engubo'. The second beat carries the turn well.
rows.rewrite: Izicathulo zisemakhoneni engubo. Umoya omncane uyamukeleka, isihlabathi asamukeleki.

rows.en: Walk now or don't walk at all. The Lowveld gives you until seven.
rows.draft: Hamba manje noma ungahambi nhlobo. I-Lowveld ikunika kuze kube ngu-7.
rows.reason: 'Hamba manje' reads as 'leave now', not 'go for a walk'; and the time should be 'ngo-7' as in the confirmed lines, not 'ngu-7'.
rows.rewrite: Uma uzohamba ngezinyawo, hamba manje. I-Lowveld ikunika kuze kube ngo-7 kuphela.

rows.en: Forgot to switch the electric blanket on in advance. Every. Single. Night.
rows.draft: Ngikhohlwe ukuvula ingubo kagesi kusenesikhathi. Njalo. Njalo. Ebusuku.
rows.reason: 'Njalo. Njalo. Ebusuku.' reads 'Always. Always. At night.' and loses the every-single-night beat; a speaker would say 'ubusuku nobusuku' and just say i-electric blanket.
rows.rewrite: Ngikhohlwe futhi ukuvula i-electric blanket kusenesikhathi. Njalo nje. Ubusuku nobusuku.

rows.en: Those clouds are only passing through. Even the mealies know not to get excited.
rows.draft: Lawo mafu adlula nje. Ngisho nommbila uyazi ukuthi akufanele ujabule.
rows.reason: 'nommbila' is misspelt: isiZulu is umbila, so 'ngisho nombila'. Otherwise natural and the turn lands.
rows.rewrite: Lawo mafu adlula nje. Ngisho nombila uyazi ukuthi akufanele ujabule.

rows.en: A few clouds came along to watch. Also not running.
rows.draft: Amafu ambalwa eze ukuzobuka. Nawo awagijimi.
rows.reason: 'eze' is the participial form and cannot carry the main clause; a speaker would say 'afikile ezobukela'. 'Nawo awagijimi' is good.
rows.rewrite: Amafu ambalwa afikile ezobukela. Nawo awagijimi.

rows.en: The sun is really milking this exit. Honestly, deserved.
rows.draft: Ilanga lishona kancane, lizibukisa ngempela. Kodwa liyakufanele.
rows.reason: Slow sunset showing off reads naturally; 'liyakufanele' carries the 'deserved' turn warmly.

rows.en: The evening is tiptoeing in on socks.
rows.draft: Kusihlwa kufika ngezinzwane, sengathi kufake amasokisi.
rows.reason: 'Kusihlwa' is the adverb 'in the evening' and is awkward as the subject; a speaker would say 'Ukuhlwa kungena ngezinzwane'. The tiptoe and socks image is good.
rows.rewrite: Ukuhlwa kungena ngezinzwane, sengathi kufake amasokisi.

rows.en: The clouds are passing the moon around. The balcony is happy to wait.
rows.draft: Amafu adlulisela inyanga komunye nomunye. I-balcony iyajabula ukulinda.
rows.reason: 'adlulisela inyanga komunye nomunye' is stiff and translated; the reciprocal 'adlulisana' is what a speaker says. 'iyajabula ukulinda' reads better as 'ijabule ukulinda'.
rows.rewrite: Amafu adlulisana ngenyanga. I-balcony ijabule ukulinda.

rows.en: The corner flag is pointing out exactly where the conversions will drift.
rows.draft: Ifulegi lasekhoneni likhomba ngqo lapho ibhola lizophambukela khona.
rows.reason: Natural and clear: the corner flag shows where the ball will veer, and the wind joke comes through.

rows.en: Midlands mist: the countryside's privacy setting.
rows.draft: Inkungu yase-Midlands: isilungiselelo sobumfihlo sasemaphandleni.
rows.reason: 'isilungiselelo sobumfihlo' is the formal software term; natives keep 'setting' as a loan (see 'ine-setting yasebusika'), so 'i-privacy setting' lands the joke.
rows.rewrite: Inkungu yase-Midlands: i-privacy setting yasemaphandleni.

rows.en: Even the impala are standing in the shade rethinking their choices.
rows.draft: Ngisho nezimpala zimi emthunzini zicabanga kabusha ngezinqumo zazo.
rows.reason: Impala in the shade rethinking their choices reads naturally, and the heat joke lands.

rows.en: The windpump is doing the morning's work. The grass is just waving it on.
rows.draft: Impompi yomoya yenza umsebenzi wasekuseni. Utshani buyayikhuthaza nje.
rows.reason: 'impompi yomoya' reads as an air pump (tyres), not a windpump; and 'buyayikhuthaza' loses the waving image. Use the loan and 'buyayishayela ihlombe'.
rows.rewrite: I-windpump yenza wonke umsebenzi wasekuseni. Utshani buyayishayela ihlombe nje.

rows.en: The jacaranda petals are taking the bus too. The breeze bought their tickets.
rows.draft: Izimbali ze-jacaranda nazo zigibela ibhasi. Amathikithi azo athengwe ngumoya omncane.
rows.reason: The passive 'Amathikithi azo athengwe ngumoya omncane' is stiff; a speaker would make the breeze the one who bought the tickets.
rows.rewrite: Izimbali ze-jacaranda nazo zigibela ibhasi. Umoya yiwona ozithengele amathikithi.

rows.en: The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.
rows.draft: Isibhakabhaka sisuke empunga ekhanyayo saya empunga emnyama. Yilowo wonke umbukiso.
rows.reason: 'empunga ekhanyayo/emnyama' treats the stem -mpunga as a locative noun, which is off; 'Yilowo wonke umbukiso' is stiff. A speaker would say 'kumpunga okhanyayo' and 'Umbukiso uphelele lapho'.
rows.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka sisuke kumpunga okhanyayo saya kumpunga omnyama. Umbukiso uphelele lapho.

rows.en: Every window switching on is someone deciding: that's enough for today.
rows.draft: Ifasitela ngalinye elikhanyayo ngumuntu onquma ukuthi: kwanele namuhla.
rows.reason: Each lit window being someone deciding 'kwanele namuhla' is natural and warm.

rows.en: Days like this aren't earned. They're issued.
rows.draft: Izinsuku ezinje azisebenzelwa. Ziyanikezwa.
rows.reason: 'azisebenzelwa. Ziyanikezwa.' is a tight, natural two-beat turn.

rows.en: The shade is working down the rows one at a time. It's inspecting.
rows.draft: Umthunzi uhamba emigqeni, owodwa ngowodwa. Uyahlola.
rows.reason: The shade going down the rows one by one and 'Uyahlola' reads naturally and keeps the character joke.

rows.en: Half moon, half cloud, full bin. Tuesday night, as advertised.
rows.draft: Uhhafu wenyanga, uhhafu wefu, umgqomo ugcwele. NguLwesibili ebusuku, njengoba kumenyezelwe.
rows.reason: 'njengoba kumenyezelwe' (as announced) is stiff and bulletin-like, and 'uhhafu wefu' is half a single cloud; 'wamafu' and 'njengokujwayelekile' keep the bin-night joke.
rows.rewrite: Uhhafu wenyanga, uhhafu wamafu, umgqomo ugcwele. YiLwesibili ebusuku, njengokujwayelekile.

rows.en: The sun won't be inspecting the shine today. The car is fine with that.
rows.draft: Ilanga ngeke lize lizohlola ukukhazimula namuhla. Imoto ayinankinga ngalokho.
rows.reason: The sun not coming to inspect the shine, and the car being fine with it, reads naturally and keeps the dry turn.

rows.en: Even the hadeda is keeping it down. The sky set the tone.
rows.draft: Ngisho ne-hadeda ithule. Isibhakabhaka yisona esibeke isimo.
rows.reason: It matches the confirmed 'Ngisho ama-hadeda athule' register; the sky setting the mood reads naturally.

rows.en: Cape Town sends solidarity. And a spare cap.
rows.draft: IKapa lithumela ukusekela. Nekepisi elingeziwe.
rows.reason: 'elingeziwe' is misspelt: the class 5 relative of -engeziwe is 'elengeziwe'. Otherwise natural and warm.
rows.rewrite: IKapa lithumela ukusekela. Nekepisi elengeziwe.

rows.en: The foghorn is Sea Point's free white-noise machine.
rows.draft: Uphondo lwenkungu lwase-Sea Point lusicula ukuze silale, mahhala.
rows.reason: 'lusicula' means 'sings us'; sings for us is 'lusiculela'. The lullaby image for white noise works.
rows.rewrite: Uphondo lwenkungu lwase-Sea Point lusiculela ukuze silale, mahhala.

rows.en: The dog is loving this wind. He's got the only hairstyle built for it.
rows.draft: Inja iyawuthanda lo moya. Yiyona yodwa enesitayela sezinwele esenzelwe wona.
rows.reason: The dog loving the wind with the only hairstyle built for it reads naturally; the personification lands.

rows.en: One blanket, two people, zero shame.
rows.draft: Ingubo eyodwa, abantu ababili, amahloni awekho.
rows.reason: Clean three-beat list; 'amahloni awekho' is how a speaker says zero shame.

rows.en: The dust is going for gold in the low light. The match plays on through it.
rows.draft: Uthuli lukhazimula njengegolide ekukhanyeni kokushona kwelanga. Umdlalo uyaqhubeka.
rows.reason: Natural; 'khazimula njengegolide' keeps the gold image, though the 'going for gold' pun goes flat.

rows.en: The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.
rows.draft: Ithafa lonke linombala owehlisiwe. Inani lezimvu liyafana noma kunjani.
rows.reason: 'linombala owehlisiwe' and 'Inani lezimvu liyafana' are translated; a speaker would say the veld is faded and the sheep are counted the same.
rows.rewrite: Ithafa lonke lifiphele, kungathi kwehliswe umbala. Izimvu zona zibalwa ngokufanayo noma kunjani.

rows.en: The smoke has found the neighbours' yard. Saturday's braai is officially a community event.
rows.draft: Intuthu ifike egcekeni labomakhelwane. Ibraai yangoMgqibelo manje ingumcimbi womphakathi ngokusemthethweni.
rows.reason: Natural; 'ngokusemthethweni' carries the mock-official turn like 'isikhalazo esisemthethweni' in the confirmed lines.

rows.en: The clouds stayed late just for the colour. Monday owed everyone that much.
rows.draft: Amafu ahlale isikhathi eside ngenxa yombala kuphela. UMsombuluko ubukweleta wonke umuntu lokho.
rows.reason: 'ahlale isikhathi eside ngenxa yombala kuphela' says stayed long only because of the colour, not stayed late to give colour; 'ubukweleta wonke umuntu' is stiff.
rows.rewrite: Amafu ahlale kwaze kwahlwa, ukuze nje alethe umbala. UMsombuluko ubusikweleta lokho.

rows.en: The Karoo is opening its roof for the night. Dress warm for the show.
rows.draft: IKaroo ivula uphahla lwayo ebusuku. Gqoka izingubo ezifudumele ukubuka umbukiso.
rows.reason: The Karoo opening its roof reads well; 'ukubuka umbukiso' is a little doubled but natural.

rows.en: Even the people who swear it never gets cold are admitting it.
rows.draft: Ngisho nalabo abafunga ukuthi akuze kubande bayavuma manje.
rows.reason: Natural, close to the confirmed 'Ngisho abaseCape bayavuma kubanda'.

rows.en: The mountain's tablecloth is only half on. It's Monday, nobody's fully dressed.
rows.draft: Indwangu yetafula yentaba igqokwe uhhafu kuphela. NguMsombuluko, akekho ogqoke ngokuphelele.
rows.reason: 'igqokwe uhhafu' (the cloth has been worn half) is awkward; let the mountain wear it so the 'dressed' turn lands.
rows.rewrite: Intaba igqoke indwangu yayo yetafula uhhafu kuphela. NguMsombuluko, akekho ogqoke ngokuphelele.

rows.en: Her hair got to the bakery first. The breeze has its own Sunday plans.
rows.draft: Izinwele zakhe zifike kuqala esitolo sesinkwa. Umoya omncane unezinhlelo zawo zangeSonto.
rows.reason: Natural; the breeze with Sunday plans keeps the weather-as-character turn.

rows.en: The flags are still chatting. The boats have called it a week.
rows.draft: Amafulegi asaxoxa. Izikebhe seziyiqedile iviki.
rows.reason: Agreement: iviki is class 5, so the object concord is -li- ('seziliqedile'), not -yi-.
rows.rewrite: Amafulegi asaxoxa. Izikebhe zona seziliqedile iviki.

rows.en: Gqeberha, we know. We know.
rows.draft: Gqeberha, siyazi. Siyazi impela.
rows.reason: Exactly how a speaker would say it; 'impela' gives the weary repeat.

rows.en: The sand is crossing the road a grain at a time. Nobody here is in a hurry.
rows.draft: Isihlabathi siwela umgwaqo inhlamvu ngenhlamvu. Akekho lapha ojahile.
rows.reason: 'inhlamvu ngenhlamvu' and 'Akekho lapha ojahile' are natural and keep the slow dry turn.

rows.en: Moon behind a cloud, dog on the stoep. Sunday's service is over.
rows.draft: Inyanga ingemuva kwefu, inja iku-stoep. Inkonzo yangeSonto iphelile.
rows.reason: Natural, uses the confirmed 'ku-stoep'; the church-service turn lands.

rows.en: Sun, then cloud, then sun. Even the monkeys can't plan around that.
rows.draft: Ilanga, bese kuba ifu, bese kuba ilanga. Ngisho nezinkawu azikwazi ukuhlela ngalokho.
rows.reason: 'bese kuba ifu, bese kuba ilanga' is stiff, and 'ukuhlela ngalokho' (plan with that) is translated for 'plan around'.
rows.rewrite: Ilanga, bese kuba namafu, bese liphuma futhi. Ngisho nezinkawu azikwazi ukuhlela lutho.

rows.en: Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights made an effort.
rows.draft: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka kumpunga ngokufanayo. Izibani zasesikhumulweni kuphela ezizamile.
rows.reason: 'isikhumulo' is a harbour/port, not a pier; people just say i-pier. 'kumpunga ngokufanayo' is stiff.
rows.rewrite: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka kokubili kumpunga. Izibani ze-pier kuphela ezizamile.

rows.en: The sun's clocked out. The clouds are still lit, and so is the balcony.
rows.draft: Ilanga seliphumile emsebenzini. Amafu asakhanya, ne-balcony nayo.
rows.reason: 'seliphumile emsebenzini' is a good clock-out; the 'lit' double meaning is lost but the line reads warm.

rows.en: Breezy
rows.draft: Kunomoya omncane
rows.held: not applied: the slot already holds a line
rows.reason: Plain and natural label, same shape as 'Kunamafu kancane'.

rows.en: The sun is doing admin out here. Heat was not part of the package.
rows.draft: Ilanga lenza i-admin laphandle. Ukushisa bekungeyona ingxenye yephakethe.
rows.reason: 'laphandle' leans isiXhosa (phandle); isiZulu says 'lapha ngaphandle'. 'ingxenye yephakethe' is a literal 'part of the package'.
rows.rewrite: Ilanga lenza i-admin lapha ngaphandle. Ukushisa bekungekho ku-package.

rows.en: A little dust devil is riding ahead of him. It isn't even pedalling.
rows.draft: Isivunguvungu esincane sothuli sihamba phambi kwakhe. Futhi asizihluphi ngokushova.
rows.reason: 'isivunguvungu sothuli' and 'ukushova' are right; the not-even-pedalling turn lands.

rows.en: Somebody forgot the washing. The breeze didn't, and it's doing a lovely job.
rows.draft: Othile ukhohliwe izingubo. Umoya omncane wona awukhohlwanga, futhi wenza umsebenzi omuhle.
rows.reason: Natural; 'wona awukhohlwanga' gives the breeze its turn as a character.

rows.en: The rocks will be handing out today's heat all night. Free of charge.
rows.draft: Amatshe azokwaba ukushisa kwanamuhla ubusuku bonke. Mahhala.
rows.reason: 'azokwaba ukushisa' is idiomatic; 'Mahhala.' lands dry.

rows.en: Sunglasses on, sunglasses off, sunglasses on. Friday afternoon is interval training.
rows.draft: Izibuko zelanga ziyagqokwa, ziyakhunyulwa, ziyagqokwa. ULwesihlanu ntambama kungukuzivocavoca.
rows.reason: Rhythm of the on-off-on repeat survives; 'kungukuzivocavoca' carries the training joke.

rows.en: The sun is buffering. Do not refresh the page.
rows.draft: Ilanga lisalayisha. Ungalivuseleli ikhasi.
rows.reason: 'Ungalivuseleli ikhasi' forces 'vuselela' where people just say refresh; 'lisalayisha' is fine.
rows.rewrite: Ilanga lisalayisha. Ungenzi i-refresh.

rows.en: Prettiest blue sky in the country, and it feels like a fridge with a view.
rows.draft: Isibhakabhaka esiluhlaza esihle kakhulu ezweni lonke, kodwa kuzwakala sengathi usefrijini elinombukiso.
rows.reason: 'umbukiso' is a show/exhibition, not a view (umbukwane); concord 'elinombukiso' treats ifriji as class 5 where the corpus has it as class 9 ('Ifriji ibonakala'); 'esiluhlaza' is redundant and ambiguous green/blue.
rows.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka esihle kakhulu ezweni lonke, kodwa kubanda sengathi usefrijini enombukwane omuhle.

rows.en: No colours in the sky tonight, just shades of calm.
rows.draft: Ayikho imibala esibhakabhakeni kulobu busuku, kuphela ukuthula.
rows.reason: 'kuphela ukuthula' is word-order calqued from English; a speaker puts kuphela after the noun ('ama-vibes kuphela') and needs a verb.
rows.rewrite: Ayikho imibala esibhakabhakeni kulobu busuku, kukhona ukuthula kuphela.

rows.en: Trout weather. Lovely for the fish. Character-building for the fisherman.
rows.draft: Isimo sezulu se-trout. Kumnandi ezinhlanzini. Kuyakha isimilo somdobi.
rows.reason: Three clean beats; 'isimilo' as the ironic 'character' is attested in kept lines ('ukuhlolwa kwesimilo').

rows.en: Lowveld summer: you don't sweat, you melt with dignity.
rows.draft: Ihlobo lase-Lowveld: awujuluki, uyancibilika ngesithunzi.
rows.reason: Mirrors the kept 'Awujuluki' line; 'uyancibilika ngesithunzi' is natural and the dignity turn lands.

rows.en: The windpump doesn't believe in knock-off time. Neither does the dog.
rows.draft: Impompi yomoya ayikholelwa esikhathini sokuphuma emsebenzini. Nenja ayikholelwa kuso.
rows.reason: 'Impompi yomoya' reads as an air/tyre pump, people just say windpump; 'isikhathi sokuphuma emsebenzini' is stiff where everyday isiZulu says 'ukushayisa'.
rows.rewrite: I-windpump ayikholelwa ekushayiseni. Nenja nayo ayikholelwa.

rows.en: We don't talk about today. Today is over. We're proud of us.
rows.draft: Asikhulumi nganamuhla. Namuhla sekuphelile. Siyaziqhenya ngathi.
rows.reason: '-ziqhenya' is already reflexive, so 'ngathi' is a doubled translation of 'of us'; 'nganamuhla' is awkward for 'about today'.
rows.rewrite: Asikhulumi ngosuku lwanamuhla. Namuhla sekuphelile. Siyaziqhenya.

rows.en: The sun took its time this morning. Worth the wait.
rows.draft: Ilanga lithathe isikhathi salo ekuseni. Ukulinda bekukufanele.
rows.reason: 'lithathe isikhathi salo' is a word-for-word calque of 'took its time'; a speaker says the sun was slow/late ('liphuze ukuphuma').
rows.rewrite: Ilanga liphuze ukuphuma ekuseni. Kodwa bekukufanele ukulinda.

rows.en: The 7am sun isn't giving heat yet. Only vibes.
rows.draft: Ilanga lango-7 ekuseni alikakhiphi ukushisa. Yi-vibe nje.
rows.reason: Natural with the code-switched 'vibe' the natives kept ('I-vibe yi-beige'); 'alikakhiphi ukushisa' is understood as is.

rows.en: The security light came on early. The sun never properly clocked in.
rows.draft: Isibani sezokuphepha sikhanyise kusenesikhathi. Ilanga alizange liqale umsebenzi kahle.
rows.reason: 'Isibani sezokuphepha' and 'kusenesikhathi' are right; the sun-never-started-work turn carries the clock-in joke.

rows.en: Relax, the mountains are just buffering.
rows.draft: Phumula, izintaba zisalayisha nje.
rows.reason: 'Phumula' means rest, not relax/chill; 'zisalayisha' (loading a truck) is not the buffering word the natives kept ('siyabafura').
rows.rewrite: Phola, izintaba ziyabafura nje.

rows.en: The sea is 12 degrees. By ten o'clock it's going to feel like a spa.
rows.draft: Ulwandle luyi-12 degrees. Ngo-10 kuzozwakala njenge-spa.
rows.reason: Plain, natural code-switch ('12 degrees', 'spa'); the ironic turn survives.

rows.en: Flags out straight, wine held tight. The deck's version of a calm Monday.
rows.draft: Amafulegi aqonde ngqo, iwayini libanjwe ngokuqinile. Yile ndlela i-deck ebona ngayo uMsombuluko ozolile.
rows.reason: 'Yile ndlela i-deck ebona ngayo' is a stiff rendering of 'the deck's version of'; 'libanjwe ngokuqinile' is bookish.
rows.rewrite: Amafulegi aqondile ngenxa yomoya, iwayini libanjwe liqinile. UMsombuluko ozolile lowo, ngokwe-deck.

rows.en: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vines. The farm arranges its own rain.
rows.draft: Amafu okushona kwelanga, amanzi okunisela amagilebhisi. Ipulazi lizilungiselela imvula yalo.
rows.reason: 'amanzi okunisela' loses the sprinklers people just call ama-sprinkler; 'lizilungiselela' means prepares for, not arranges/makes its own rain.
rows.rewrite: Amafu ahlobisa ukushona kwelanga, ama-sprinkler anisela amagilebhisi. Ipulazi lizenzela imvula yalo.

rows.en: Cloud shadows crossing the outfield at a steady walk. Nobody's appealing.
rows.draft: Izithunzi zamafu zihamba kancane ziwela inkundla. Akekho okhalazayo.
rows.reason: 'okhalazayo' means complaining, so the cricket appeal joke is gone and 'inkundla' no longer says cricket.
rows.rewrite: Izithunzi zamafu ziwela inkundla yekhilikithi kancane. Akekho ofaka i-appeal.

rows.en: That one little light is someone doing winter correctly: hut, fire, done.
rows.draft: Lokho kukhanya okukodwa okuncane ngumuntu owenza ubusika kahle: iqhugwane, umlilo, kuphelile.
rows.reason: 'owenza ubusika kahle' is a calque of 'doing winter correctly'; 'kuphelile' reads as 'it's over/finished', not 'sorted'.
rows.rewrite: Lokho kukhanya okuncane kungumuntu owazi ukwenza ubusika: iqhugwane, umlilo, sekulungile.

rows.en: The mountain pulled the duvet over its head. Fair enough, it's Friday.
rows.draft: Intaba izembese ingubo ekhanda. Kulungile, nguLwesihlanu.
rows.reason: 'Intaba izembese ingubo' gives the mountain a person's habit naturally; the Friday turn lands.

rows.en: Jeffreys Bay: where the wind warms up before its Cape Town shift.
rows.draft: IJeffreys Bay: lapho umoya uzilolongela khona ngaphambi kweshifu yawo eKapa.
rows.reason: 'uzilolongela' (warming up/training) and the code-switched 'ishifu' make the wind a worker; reads natural.

rows.en: The sprinkler is supposedly for the lawn. Look who's all standing in the water.
rows.draft: Amanzi okunisela kuthiwa awotshani. Bheka ukuthi ngobani abemi emanzini.
rows.reason: 'abemi' reads as the noun 'residents/citizens', not 'those standing' (abame); 'amanzi okunisela' drops the sprinkler.
rows.rewrite: I-sprinkler kuthiwa ingeyotshani. Bheka ukuthi ngobani abame emanzini.

rows.en: The whole city had the same plan tonight. Look at us all.
rows.draft: Lonke idolobha libe nesu elifanayo kulobu busuku. Bheka thina sonke.
rows.reason: 'Bheka thina sonke' is translated; a speaker says 'Sibheke' (look at us), and 'Lonke idolobha' order is stiff.
rows.rewrite: Idolobha lonke libe nesu elilodwa kulobu busuku. Sibheke nje sonke.

rows.en: The blesbok wear no scarves and file no complaints. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.
rows.draft: Ama-blesbok awagqoki zikhafu futhi awakhali. Singafunda okuthile. Ngeke, kodwa singafunda.
rows.reason: Correct negative forms ('awagqoki zikhafu'); colloquial 'awakhali' for no complaints; the self-mocking last beat works.

rows.en: Break time, and the breeze is doing everyone's hair. Teachers included.
rows.draft: Yisikhathi sekhefu, futhi umoya omncane ulungisa izinwele zabo bonke. Nothisha.
rows.reason: 'ulungisa izinwele' means tidying hair, losing the ironic 'doing hair' (ukwenza izinwele); bare 'Nothisha' needs 'Ngisho' to read as 'teachers included'.
rows.rewrite: Yisikhathi sekhefu, umoya omncane wenza izinwele zabo bonke. Ngisho nothisha.

rows.en: The moon's on a dimmer tonight. The security light has no such setting.
rows.draft: Inyanga ikhanya kancane kulobu busuku. Isibani sezokuphepha asinalo lelo khono.
rows.reason: Natural; 'asinalo lelo khono' turns the missing setting into a missing skill, which keeps the jab.

rows.en: The sky's on mute and so is the queue. Monday hasn't found the volume.
rows.draft: Isibhakabhaka sithulile, nolayini uthulile. UMsombuluko awukayitholi ivolumu.
rows.reason: Everyday 'ulayini' and 'ivolumu', correct concords; the quiet-Monday turn carries.

rows.en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.
rows.draft: Uhhafu wezinkanyezi ungemuva kwamafu. Izibani ezincane zizibambele.
rows.reason: 'zizibambele' has the reflexive -zi- (holding for themselves); 'covering for them' is 'ayazibambela'. 'Izibani ezincane' flattens the fairy lights; people just say 'ama-fairy lights'.
rows.rewrite: Ingxenye yezinkanyezi ingemuva kwamafu. Ama-fairy lights ayazibambela.

rows.en: The breeze is taking the smoke down the block. The whole street knows what's for supper.
rows.draft: Umoya omncane uthwala intuthu wehle nomgwaqo. Wonke umgwaqo uyazi ukuthi kudliwani kusihlwa.
rows.reason: 'uthwala intuthu wehle nomgwaqo' is stiff and translated; 'wonke umgwaqo uyazi' repeats umgwaqo and reads oddly. A speaker would say the neighbours know.
rows.rewrite: Umoya omncane uhambisa intuthu emgwaqweni wonke. Bonke omakhelwane sebeyazi ukuthi kudliwani kusihlwa.

rows.en: Purple on the ground, white in the sky. Friday's colour scheme is approved.
rows.draft: Okunsomi phansi, okumhlophe esibhakabhakeni. Imibala kaLwesihlanu yamukelwe.
rows.reason: Clean two-beat contrast; 'yamukelwe' for approved matches the confirmed 'samukelwe' line.

rows.en: The leaves keep setting off the security light. The dog's stopped getting up for them.
rows.draft: Amaqabunga ahlala ekhanyisa isibani sezokuphepha. Inja ayisasukumi ngenxa yawo.
rows.reason: Natural and literal in the way the natives keep; the dog's indifference carries the joke.

rows.en: The sheets are dry already. Now the breeze is just showing off for the kid.
rows.draft: Amashidi asomile kakade. Manje umoya omncane uziqhayisa nje enganeni.
rows.reason: Reads naturally; 'uziqhayisa nje enganeni' gives the breeze character as the English does.

rows.en: Somebody's mom is going to have words. Worth it.
rows.draft: Umama womuntu othile uzothethisa. Kodwa bekumnandi.
rows.reason: 'uzothethisa' is exactly 'have words'; 'Kodwa bekumnandi' turns 'worth it' into the kid's warm verdict.

rows.en: Cape Town after a front: clean, bright, and honestly freezing.
rows.draft: IKapa ngemuva kwe-front: licwebile, liyakhanya, futhi liyabanda impela.
rows.reason: 'IKapa ... liyabanda' makes the city itself cold; a speaker says 'eKapa kubanda'. 'i-front' is a forced loan; 'licwebile' is for sky or water, not a clean city.
rows.rewrite: EKapa emva kwemvula: konke kuhlanzekile, kuyakhanya, futhi kubanda impela.

rows.en: Every light on the string is swaying. Saturday night has rhythm, barely.
rows.draft: Zonke izibani ezisentanjeni ziyanyakaza. UMgqibelo ebusuku unesigqi, kancane nje.
rows.reason: 'UMgqibelo ebusuku unesigqi' is translated word order; a speaker says 'ubusuku bangoMgqibelo'.
rows.rewrite: Zonke izibani ezisentanjeni ziyanyakaza. Ubusuku bangoMgqibelo bunesigqi, kancane nje.

rows.en: The breeze does all the work. The kite takes all the credit.
rows.draft: Umoya wenza wonke umsebenzi. I-kite ithatha lonke udumo.
rows.reason: Crisp parallel turn; 'i-kite' avoids the old umkhumbi trap and 'udumo' is the right word for credit.

rows.en: Bit of a breeze.
rows.draft: Kunomoya omncane.
rows.held: not applied: the slot already holds a line
rows.reason: Exactly how a speaker says it; plain and warm.

rows.en: The clouds turned pink right on packing-up time. Nobody packed up.
rows.draft: Amafu aphenduke abe yi-pink ngqo ngesikhathi sokupakisha. Akekho opakishile.
rows.reason: One slip: after the perfect 'aphenduke', 'abe' should be 'aba'; otherwise natural, and 'Akekho opakishile' lands.
rows.rewrite: Amafu aphenduka aba-pink ngqo ngesikhathi sokupakisha. Akekho opakishile.

rows.en: The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.
rows.draft: Isibani esibayeni yikho ukushona kwelanga kulobu busuku. Izinkomo ziyakwamukela ukwehliswa.
rows.reason: 'yikho ukushona kwelanga' has the wrong copula ('yikho' = that's why); 'ukwehliswa' (being demoted) is stiff for 'downgrade'.
rows.rewrite: Isibani sasesibayeni yilanga elishonayo kusihlwa namuhla. Izinkomo azikhonondi, ziyamukela.

rows.en: The flag's giving the forecast before the surfers do. It says: go.
rows.draft: Ifulegi linikeza isibikezelo ngaphambi kwabagibeli bamagagasi. Lithi: hambani.
rows.reason: 'linikeza isibikezelo' is stiff; 'hambani' reads as 'go away/leave', not 'go surf'.
rows.rewrite: Ifulegi libikezela isimo ngaphambi kwabagibeli bamagagasi. Lithi: ngenani olwandle.

rows.en: The breeze is working the fruit stall today. Air-con included, no extra charge.
rows.draft: Umoya omncane usebenza etafuleni lezithelo namuhla. I-air-con ifakiwe, ayikho imali eyengeziwe.
rows.reason: The breeze as a stall worker reads naturally; 'I-air-con ifakiwe' is the code-switch people use.

rows.en: Clouds today, vibes optional.
rows.draft: Amafu namuhla. Imizwa yona ikuwe.
rows.reason: 'Imizwa yona ikuwe' means 'the feelings are you', not 'optional/up to you' ('kukuwe'); vibes is 'ama-vibes' in the confirmed lines.
rows.rewrite: Amafu namuhla. Ama-vibes wona kukuwe.

rows.en: Properly cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.
rows.draft: Kubanda impela namuhla. Uhlobo olungena emajezini amathathu sengathi awekho.
rows.reason: 'Uhlobo olungena...' floats without a noun (kind of what?); a speaker names the cold: 'Amakhaza angena...'.
rows.rewrite: Kubanda impela namuhla. Amakhaza angena ngisho emajezini amathathu sengathi awekho.

rows.en: Sundowners aren't a luxury in the Lowveld. They're medical.
rows.draft: Ama-sundowner akuwona ubukhazikhazi e-Lowveld. Angumuthi.
rows.reason: 'ubukhazikhazi' means splendour/glitter, not luxury ('ubunethezeka'); 'Angumuthi' lands well.
rows.rewrite: E-Lowveld ama-sundowner akusibo ubunethezeka. Angumuthi.

rows.en: The tablecloth is pressed and ready for tomorrow's service.
rows.draft: Indwangu yetafula ilungisiwe, ilungele umsebenzi wakusasa.
rows.reason: 'Indwangu yetafula' is a literal kitchen tablecloth; without the mountain named the reader loses the joke (confirmed line names it). 'ilungisiwe, ilungele' is repetitive.
rows.rewrite: Indwangu yeNtaba yeThebula isilungile, ilindele umsebenzi wakusasa.

rows.en: The South-Easter has no off switch. We've looked.
rows.draft: I-South-Easter ayinayo iswishi yokuyicima. Siyifunile.
rows.reason: Natural; 'Siyifunile' is a dry, exact second beat.

rows.en: One cloud over the mountain is not a weather event. The fire stays lit.
rows.draft: Ifu elilodwa phezu kwentaba alisona isimo sezulu. Umlilo uqhubeka uvutha.
rows.reason: Reads naturally and keeps the dry dismissal; 'Umlilo uqhubeka uvutha' is clear.

rows.en: Sky and sea agreed on a colour this morning. Not an exciting one.
rows.draft: Isibhakabhaka nolwandle kuvumelene ngombala ekuseni. Akuwona umbala ojabulisayo.
rows.reason: Natural; the flat second beat carries the honest-mediocrity joke.

rows.en: The dog found the exact line between sun and shade. He's staying put.
rows.draft: Inja ithole umngcele ngqo phakathi kwelanga nomthunzi. Ihlala khona.
rows.reason: 'umngcele ngqo phakathi kwelanga nomthunzi' is clear and the dog gets his dignity.

rows.en: The cattle are home before the colour goes. Sunday ends exactly on schedule.
rows.draft: Izinkomo sezisekhaya ngaphambi kokuba umbala uphele. ISonto liphela ngesikhathi ngqo.
rows.reason: 'umbala uphele' (the colour finishes) is unclear without the sunset; cattle come home to the kraal, 'esibayeni'.
rows.rewrite: Izinkomo sezisesibayeni ngaphambi kokuba kuphele imibala yokushona kwelanga. ISonto liphela ngesikhathi ngqo.

rows.en: Grey sky, jerseys on, school's out. The weekend doesn't need the sun's permission.
rows.draft: Isibhakabhaka esimpunga, amajezi agqokiwe, isikole siphumile. Impelasonto ayidingi imvume yelanga.
rows.reason: 'isikole siphumile' is the everyday phrase; the sun's permission turn works.
